### Signatures of loop quantum gravity in primordial black hole cosmologies

*With Sébastien Clesse and Francesca Vidotto.*

In the Planck-scale remnant model we study, primordial black holes of about one tonne can reheat the early universe through Hawking evaporation and leave remnants that account for today’s dark matter.

[Read on arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28953){.btn-surface .c-indigo .btn-compact .release-btn}
:::

### `pbh-rem`

Mathematica notebooks for modelling the evolution of primordial black holes and their remnants, and computing cosmological bounds on their abundances.

[View the code](https://github.com/adierckx/pbh-rem){.btn-surface .c-teal .btn-compact .release-btn}
